name: WANTED: Baron Vardus
summary: In Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia calls for Baron Vardus's death. The human is a high-ranking member of the Syndicate, wanted for crimes against the Forsaken; bring proof of his death to Darthalia.

sections.title: A Price on the Baron
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia has put a price on Baron Vardus, a human accused of crimes against the Forsaken and counted among the Syndicate's high-ranking members. The last word placed him in the Uplands of the Alterac Mountains, north of Tarren Mill. Darthalia's order calls for his death, and payment awaits whoever brings her proof.

sections.title: Where He Might Be
sections.body: Baron Vardus may be at any of the Syndicate camps across the Uplands. He may also be hiding in the cellar of the inn at Strahnbrad.

sections.title: Darthalia's Verdict
sections.body: With Baron Vardus dead, High Executor Darthalia declares that the Syndicate's leaders are fewer. She expects their anger and resistance to be short-lived.

faq.answer: Baron Vardus is a human and a high-ranking member of the Syndicate, wanted for crimes against the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where can Baron Vardus be found?
faq.answer: Baron Vardus was last seen north of Tarren Mill, in the Uplands of the Alterac Mountains. He may be at one of the Syndicate camps there or hiding in the cellar of the Strahnbrad inn.

faq.q: Who offers the bounty on Baron Vardus?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia offers the bounty on Baron Vardus. Bring proof of his death to her in Tarren Mill.
